summary: A patient, plan-aligned win: your pre-market and check-in both said you wanted NWOG filled once price failed to continue higher, and you shorted only after the manipulation into the 4hr unfill and a 5min displacement flip, then held it into lunch on 1 XFA. Before that you missed the long off the Asia-low SMT and 4hr rejection block because you were waiting for a manipulation that never came, and you wrote that down honestly. Your entry was also late: by your own Discord post you missed the ideal entry because you were in the restroom, so you took a wider stop than the setup needed. The accountability side slipped. The risk screenshot came in at 9:31 after the bot's 9:30 warning, and there is still no End of Day card in the pair channel. Gmail shows no new eval or account purchases today.
trade: Short · NY-AM · XFA · Win (RR 1.53 logged) · entry about 28,753 around 10:55 to 11:00 AM after the manipulation into the 4hr unfill (NYAM.H about 28,890) · stop about 28,899 above the 5min highs (about 146 pts) · target about 28,541.75 toward the NWOG fill (about 211 pts, roughly 1.45R) · levels read from the 11:01 5min chart posted in Discord, which is blurry, so they're approximate. Missed long earlier: CISD about 28,719, stop about 28,665, 4hr unfill about 28,859 (about 2.6R) on the 10:49 chart.

good: The trade matched your plan: the check-in said you'd wait for NWOG to fill once price failed to continue higher, and the short came only after the manipulation into the 4hr unfill.
You stayed in NY-AM on one XFA, with no Asia trading and no copy trading after Friday's blown accounts.
Your stop was above the 5min highs and the manipulation high (about 28,890 to 28,899), not inside the leg.
You held a higher-timeframe trade into lunch while calm, instead of cutting it early.
You wrote up the missed long honestly, with the exact reason ('overthinked... wanted to see manipulation').
No new eval or account purchases in Gmail today.
fix: The risk-settings screenshot was late: the bot warned at 9:30 and you posted 'oops' at 9:31. It's the mandatory part of the check-in, so post it together with the card.
No End of Day card in the pair channel yet, even though you won. File it today before the 12 AM deadline.

You missed the ideal entry because you were in the restroom, so you took a wider stop of about 146 pts for about 1.5R. Handle breaks before 9:30 or after you're in, not while you're waiting for the setup.

Waiting for a specific manipulation cost you a 2.6R long. If the confluences are stacked and the CISD prints, the CISD is the confirmation; don't require an extra sweep you didn't write into the plan.
You slept a lot less than usual. On short sleep, cut size or the number of ideas ahead of time, not after a loss.
